  <script>
    const COGNITO_CLIENT_ID = "79d4qhnedttr14qh6gakkh5hk0";
    const COGNITO_REGION = "ca-central-1";
    const API_URL = "https://85hyx9ie7d.execute-api.ca-central-1.amazonaws.com/prod/Contact"; 
    
    // Microsoft Client ID for OAuth
    const MS_CLIENT_ID = "359dc7f8-359d-47ab-abcf-c0129559aacb";

    const loginScreen = document.getElementById('admin-login-screen');
    const crmScreen = document.getElementById('admin-crm-screen');
    const loginForm = document.getElementById('admin-login-form');
    const logoutBtn = document.getElementById('admin-logout-btn');
    const displayEmail = document.getElementById('active-admin-email');
    const modal = document.getElementById('client-modal');
    
    let activeClientEmail = ""; 
    let activeClientTimestamp = ""; 
    let activeClientPhone = ""; 
    
    let existingFinalFiles = [];
    let newFinalFilesQueue = []; 

    window.allClients = [];

    function parseJwt(token) {
      try {
        const base64Url = token.split('.')[1];
        const base64 = base64Url.replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/');
        const jsonPayload = decodeURIComponent(window.atob(base64).split('').map(function(c) {
          return '%' + ('00' + c.charCodeAt(0).toString(16)).slice(-2);
        }).join(''));
        return JSON.parse(jsonPayload);
      } catch (e) { return null; }
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      const token = localStorage.getItem('admin_id_token');
      const email = localStorage.getItem('admin_email');
      const payload = token ? parseJwt(token) : null;
      const groups = payload ? payload['cognito:groups'] || [] : [];
      if (token && email && groups.includes('Staff')) { showCRM(email); } else if (token) { showLogin(); }
    });

    // Microsoft OAuth Redirection Logic
    function connectMicrosoft() {
      const redirectUri = encodeURIComponent("https://www.fiscalx.ca/admin/");
      const scope = encodeURIComponent("offline_access Calendars.ReadWrite Mail.Send User.Read");
      const authUrl = `https://login.microsoftonline.com/common/oauth2/v2.0/authorize?client_id=${MS_CLIENT_ID}&response_type=code&redirect_uri=${redirectUri}&scope=${scope}&response_mode=query`;
      window.location.href = authUrl;
    }

   // QuickBooks OAuth Redirection Logic
function connectQuickBooks() {
  const scope = encodeURIComponent("com.intuit.quickbooks.accounting");
  const state = "fiscalx_qbo_auth";
  
  // Dynamically build redirectUri so it matches your active browser address perfectly!
  const redirectUri = encodeURIComponent(window.location.origin + "/admin/");
  
  const authUrl = `https://appcenter.intuit.com/connect/oauth2?client_id=ABpC4zd9xPXxZkN9AgXd8mGM2EvvT1Uiw1bt9BvUJHBRxvoXex&response_type=code&scope=${scope}&redirect_uri=${redirectUri}&state=${state}`;
  window.location.href = authUrl;
}

async function showCRM(email) {
      loginScreen.classList.add('hidden'); crmScreen.classList.remove('hidden'); displayEmail.innerText = email;
      
      const msBtn = document.getElementById('btn-ms-connect');
      if (msBtn) msBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
      
      const qboBtn = document.getElementById('btn-qbo-connect');
      if (qboBtn) qboBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
      
const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      const authCode = urlParams.get('code');
      const authState = urlParams.get('state');
      const realmId = urlParams.get('realmId'); // Grab QBO Company ID

      if (authCode) {
        window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname);
        
        if (authState === 'fiscalx_qbo_auth') {
            // ROUTE TO QUICKBOOKS BACKEND
            document.getElementById('kanban-status').innerText = "Exchanging QuickBooks Token securely...";
            try {
              const qboRes = await fetch(API_URL, {
                method: 'POST', 
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('admin_access_token') },
                body: JSON.stringify({ 
                  action: "exchangeQboCode", 
                  adminEmail: email, 
                  code: authCode, 
                  realmId: realmId,
                  redirectUri: window.location.origin + "/admin/" // <-- Send the exact URL we used!
                })
              });

              const qboData = await qboRes.json();
              if (qboData.status === 'SUCCESS') {
                alert("✅ QuickBooks Successfully Connected to AWS!");
                document.getElementById('kanban-status').innerText = "QuickBooks Synced.";
              } else {
                alert("Failed to connect QuickBooks: " + qboData.message);
              }
            } catch(e) {
              alert("Network error connecting QuickBooks to AWS.");
            }
        } else {
            // ROUTE TO MICROSOFT BACKEND
            document.getElementById('kanban-status').innerText = "Exchanging Microsoft Token securely...";
            try {
              const msRes = await fetch(API_URL, {
                method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('admin_access_token') },
                body: JSON.stringify({ action: "exchangeMsCode", adminEmail: email, code: authCode })
              });
              const msData = await msRes.json();
              if (msData.status === 'SUCCESS') {
                alert("✅ Outlook Calendar Successfully Connected to AWS!");
                document.getElementById('kanban-status').innerText = "Outlook Synced.";
              } else {
                alert("Failed to connect Outlook: " + msData.message);
              }
            } catch(e) {
              alert("Network error connecting Outlook to AWS.");
            }
        }
      } else {
        document.getElementById('kanban-status').innerText = "Syncing with secure AWS vault...";
      }

      try {
        const response = await fetch(API_URL, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('admin_access_token') }, body: JSON.stringify({ action: "getCrmData", adminEmail: email }) });
        const result = await response.json();
        if (response.ok && result.status === 'SUCCESS') {
          const deduplicatedClients = deduplicateClients(result.clients);
          const total = deduplicatedClients.length;
          const inProgress = deduplicatedClients.filter(c => c.campaignStatus === 'Pending' || c.campaignStatus === 'In Progress').length;
          const completed = deduplicatedClients.filter(c => c.campaignStatus === 'Completed').length;
          document.getElementById('stat-total').innerText = total; document.getElementById('stat-progress').innerText = inProgress; document.getElementById('stat-completed').innerText = completed;
          if (!authCode) document.getElementById('kanban-status').innerText = ""; 
          window.allClients = deduplicatedClients; renderKanbanBoard(deduplicatedClients);
        } else { document.getElementById('kanban-status').innerText = "Error fetching data."; }
      } catch (error) { document.getElementById('kanban-status').innerText = "Network Error connecting to Database."; }
    }

    function deduplicateClients(clients) {
      clients.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.timestamp) - new Date(a.timestamp));
      const uniqueClients = {};
      clients.forEach(client => {
        const email = client.userEmail.toLowerCase();
        const formTime = new Date(client.timestamp).getTime();
        let hasStandaloneUploads = false; let newestFileTimestamp = 0; 
        
        if (client.uploadedFiles) {
          client.uploadedFiles.forEach(file => {
            const filenamePart = file.fileKey.split('/').pop();
            const fileTimestamp = parseInt(filenamePart.split('-')[0]);
            if (!isNaN(fileTimestamp)) {
              if (fileTimestamp > newestFileTimestamp) newestFileTimestamp = fileTimestamp; 
              if (fileTimestamp > (formTime + 10000)) hasStandaloneUploads = true;
            }
          });
        }
        
        const lastViewed = localStorage.getItem('viewed_' + email);
        if (lastViewed && newestFileTimestamp <= parseInt(lastViewed)) hasStandaloneUploads = false;
        
        if (!uniqueClients[email]) {
          uniqueClients[email] = { 
            ...client, 
            uploadedFiles: [...(client.uploadedFiles || [])], 
            hasNewActivity: hasStandaloneUploads, 
            finalFiles: [...(client.finalFiles || [])],
            paymentConfirmed: client.paymentConfirmed || false 
          };
        } else {
          if (client.uploadedFiles && client.uploadedFiles.length > 0) {
            client.uploadedFiles.forEach(file => {
              if (!uniqueClients[email].uploadedFiles.some(f => f.fileKey === file.fileKey)) uniqueClients[email].uploadedFiles.push(file);
            });
          }
          if (client.finalFiles && client.finalFiles.length > 0) {
            client.finalFiles.forEach(file => {
              if (!uniqueClients[email].finalFiles.some(f => f.fileKey === file.fileKey)) uniqueClients[email].finalFiles.push(file);
            });
          }
          if (client.campaignStatus === "In Progress" || client.campaignStatus === "Completed") {
            if (uniqueClients[email].campaignStatus === "Pending") {
              uniqueClients[email].hasNewActivity = true; uniqueClients[email].campaignStatus = client.campaignStatus;
            }
          }
          if (hasStandaloneUploads) uniqueClients[email].hasNewActivity = true;
        }
      });
      return Object.values(uniqueClients);
    }

    function renderKanbanBoard(clients) {
      const colPending = document.getElementById('col-pending'); const colProgress = document.getElementById('col-progress'); const colCompleted = document.getElementById('col-completed');
      colPending.innerHTML = ""; colProgress.innerHTML = ""; colCompleted.innerHTML = "";
      let countPending = 0; let countProgress = 0; let countCompleted = 0;

      clients.forEach(client => {
        const dateObj = new Date(client.timestamp); const niceDate = dateObj.toLocaleDateString('en-CA', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' });
        const safeEmail = client.userEmail.replace(/'/g, "\\'"); const safeTimestamp = client.timestamp.replace(/'/g, "\\'"); 
        
        const paymentBadge = client.paymentConfirmed 
          ? `<span class="text-[9px] font-bold text-emerald-400 ml-2 border border-emerald-500/20 bg-emerald-500/10 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded">PAID</span>` : '';

        const badgeHtml = client.hasNewActivity 
          ? `<span class="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-amber-400 bg-amber-400/10 px-2.5 py-1 rounded animate-pulse border border-amber-500/20">New Activity</span>`
          : `<span class="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-teal-400 bg-teal-400/10 px-2.5 py-1 rounded">${client.taxType || 'Consultation'}</span>`;
        
        const appointmentBadge = (client.bookingDate && client.bookingTime && client.bookingDate !== "CANCELLED")
          ? `<div class="mt-2 text-[10px] font-bold text-purple-300 bg-purple-500/20 border border-purple-500/30 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-between">
               <span>📅 ${client.meetingType || 'Call'}: ${client.bookingDate} @ ${client.bookingTime}</span>
             </div>`
          : '';

        const borderClass = client.hasNewActivity ? 'border-amber-500/40 shadow-lg shadow-amber-500/5 animate-pulse' : 'border-white/5 hover:border-teal-500/50';

        // NEW ASSIGNEE BADGE: Shows the staff member's name
        const assigneeBadge = client.assignedTo && client.assignedTo !== "Unassigned" 
          ? `<span class="text-[9px] font-bold text-purple-400 bg-purple-500/10 border border-purple-500/20 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded ml-2" title="${client.assignedTo}">👤 ${client.assignedTo.split('@')[0]}</span>` 
          : '';

const cardHtml = `
          <div onclick="openModal('${safeEmail}', '${safeTimestamp}')" class="bg-[#131A2B] border ${borderClass} p-4 rounded-xl shadow-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer relative group">
            <div class="flex justify-between items-start mb-2">${badgeHtml}<span class="text-[10px] text-slate-500">${niceDate}</span></div>
            
            <div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
               <h4 class="font-bold text-sm text-slate-200 truncate flex-1">${client.clientName || 'Unnamed Client'}</h4>
               <div class="flex-shrink-0 flex gap-1">${paymentBadge} ${assigneeBadge}</div>
            </div>
            
            <p class="text-xs text-slate-400 truncate mb-1">${client.userEmail}</p>
            ${appointmentBadge}
            <div class="pt-3 mt-3 border-t border-white/5 flex justify-between items-center">
              <span class="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-300">Files: ${client.uploadedFiles ? client.uploadedFiles.length : 0}</span>
              <span class="text-xs text-teal-400 font-bold opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">Manage &rarr;</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        `;

        const status = client.campaignStatus || 'Pending';
        if (status === 'Completed') { colCompleted.innerHTML += cardHtml; countCompleted++; } else if (status === 'In Progress') { colProgress.innerHTML += cardHtml; countProgress++; } else { colPending.innerHTML += cardHtml; countPending++; }
      });
      document.getElementById('count-pending').innerText = countPending; document.getElementById('count-progress').innerText = countProgress; document.getElementById('count-completed').innerText = countCompleted;
    }

    function openModal(email, timestamp) {
      const client = window.allClients.find(c => c.userEmail === email && c.timestamp === timestamp);
      if (!client) return;
      
      activeClientEmail = email; activeClientTimestamp = timestamp; 
      
      let rawPhone = client.phone || (client.personalInfo ? client.personalInfo.telephone : "") || "";
      if (!rawPhone && (client.notes || client.message)) {
        const textToSearch = (client.notes || "") + " " + (client.message || "");
        const phoneMatch = textToSearch.match(/\d{10}/);
        if (phoneMatch) rawPhone = phoneMatch[0];
      }
      activeClientPhone = rawPhone; 

      document.getElementById('modal-client-name').innerText = client.clientName || 'Unnamed Client';
      document.getElementById('modal-client-email').innerText = client.userEmail;
      
      const taxType = client.taxType || 'T1 Personal';
      document.getElementById('modal-tax-type').innerText = taxType;

      const modalAppointmentBox = document.getElementById('modal-appointment-box');
      toggleRescheduleForm(false);

      if (modalAppointmentBox) {
        if (client.bookingDate && client.bookingTime && client.bookingDate !== "CANCELLED") {
          document.getElementById('modal-booking-format').innerText = client.meetingType || "Consultation";
          document.getElementById('modal-booking-slot').innerText = `📅 ${client.bookingDate} at ${client.bookingTime}`;
          document.getElementById('admin-reschedule-date').value = client.bookingDate;
          modalAppointmentBox.classList.remove('hidden');
        } else {
          modalAppointmentBox.classList.add('hidden');
        }
      }
      
      const dropdown = document.getElementById('modal-status-dropdown');
      dropdown.value = client.campaignStatus || 'Pending';
      const assignDropdown = document.getElementById('modal-assign-dropdown');
   if (assignDropdown) assignDropdown.value = client.assignedTo || 'Unassigned';
      
      const requestDropdown = document.getElementById('modal-request-doc');
      requestDropdown.innerHTML = ""; 
      const t1Docs = ["Prior Year Notice of Assessment (NOA)", "T4 Employment Income Slip", "Void Cheque / Direct Deposit Form", "T2202 Tuition Fees Certificate", "RRSP Contribution Receipt", "Charitable Donation Slip", "T5008 Stock/Investment Ledger", "Daycare / Child Care Invoices", "T2200 Work From Home Form", "Rideshare/Uber T2125 Expense Log", "Rental Property T776 Income Matrix"];
      const t2Docs = ["Articles of Incorporation", "Corporate Trial Balance / General Ledger", "Corporate Financial Statements", "Corporate T2 Tax Disclosures"];
      const activeDocs = taxType.includes("T2") ? t2Docs : t1Docs;
      activeDocs.forEach(doc => { requestDropdown.innerHTML += `<option value="${doc}">${doc}</option>`; });
      
      const totalFiles = client.uploadedFiles ? client.uploadedFiles.length : 0;
      document.getElementById('modal-file-title').innerText = `Secure Document Vault (${totalFiles} Merged Files)`;

      let newestFileTimestamp = 0;
      const fileListDiv = document.getElementById('modal-file-list'); fileListDiv.innerHTML = "";
      if (client.uploadedFiles && client.uploadedFiles.length > 0) {
        client.uploadedFiles.forEach(file => {
          const safeKey = file.fileKey.replace(/'/g, "\\'"); const safeName = file.fileName.replace(/'/g, "\\'");
          const fileTimestamp = parseInt(file.fileKey.split('/').pop().split('-')[0]);
          if (!isNaN(fileTimestamp) && fileTimestamp > newestFileTimestamp) newestFileTimestamp = fileTimestamp;
          fileListDiv.innerHTML += `<div class="flex items-center justify-between bg-white/5 border border-white/10 p-3 rounded-lg"><span class="text-xs text-slate-300 truncate pr-4">📄 ${file.fileName}</span><button onclick="decryptAndDownload('${safeKey}', '${safeName}', this)" class="text-[10px] font-bold text-teal-400 bg-teal-500/10 hover:bg-teal-500 hover:text-slate-950 px-3 py-1.5 rounded transition">Decrypt & Download</button></div>`;
        });
      } else { fileListDiv.innerHTML = `<p class="text-xs text-slate-500 italic">No files uploaded by this client.</p>`; }

      if (newestFileTimestamp > 0) { localStorage.setItem('viewed_' + email.toLowerCase(), newestFileTimestamp); renderKanbanBoard(window.allClients); }

      const finalDeliverablesBox = document.getElementById('final-deliverables-box');
      if (client.campaignStatus === 'Completed') {
        finalDeliverablesBox.classList.remove('hidden');
        document.getElementById('modal-payment-checkbox').checked = client.paymentConfirmed || false;
        existingFinalFiles = client.finalFiles || [];
        newFinalFilesQueue = [];
        renderFinalQueue();
      } else {
        finalDeliverablesBox.classList.add('hidden');
      }

      // Hide Delete button if client is in Completed column
      const deleteBtn = document.getElementById('btn-delete-card');
      if (deleteBtn) {
        if (client.campaignStatus === 'Completed') {
          deleteBtn.classList.add('hidden');
        } else {
          deleteBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
        }
      }

      modal.classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    function closeModal() { modal.classList.add('hidden'); activeClientEmail = ""; activeClientTimestamp = ""; activeClientPhone = ""; newFinalFilesQueue = []; }
    modal.addEventListener('click', (e) => { if (e.target === modal) closeModal(); });

    const finalUploadInput = document.getElementById('modal-final-upload');
    if (finalUploadInput) {
      finalUploadInput.addEventListener('change', () => {
        const files = finalUploadInput.files;
        for (let i = 0; i < files.length; i++) {
          if (!newFinalFilesQueue.some(f => f.name === files[i].name)) newFinalFilesQueue.push(files[i]);
        }
        renderFinalQueue();
        finalUploadInput.value = "";
      });
    }

    function renderFinalQueue() {
      const qDiv = document.getElementById('final-queue-list'); 
      if (!qDiv) return;
      qDiv.innerHTML = "";

      existingFinalFiles.forEach((file, idx) => { 
        qDiv.innerHTML += `
          <div class="flex justify-between items-center text-xs text-slate-300 bg-black/40 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-white/5">
            <span class="truncate pr-2 font-medium">🔒 ${file.fileName}</span>
            <button type="button" onclick="removeExistingFinalFile(${idx})" class="text-red-400 hover:text-red-300 font-bold transition-all px-2 py-0.5 rounded hover:bg-red-500/10">
              Delete
            </button>
          </div>`; 
      });

      newFinalFilesQueue.forEach((file, idx) => { 
        qDiv.innerHTML += `
          <div class="flex justify-between items-center text-xs text-amber-400 bg-amber-500/10 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-amber-500/20">
            <span class="truncate pr-2 font-medium">⏳ ${file.name} (Pending Save)</span>
            <button type="button" onclick="removeFinalFile(${idx})" class="text-amber-300 hover:underline font-bold">
              Remove
            </button>
          </div>`; 
      });
    }

    window.removeExistingFinalFile = function(idx) {
      if (confirm("Remove this deliverable file? Click 'Save Billing' to confirm.")) {
        existingFinalFiles.splice(idx, 1);
        renderFinalQueue();
      }
    };

    window.removeFinalFile = function(idx) { 
      newFinalFilesQueue.splice(idx, 1); 
      renderFinalQueue(); 
    };

    async function saveBillingLock(btn) {
      const adminEmail = localStorage.getItem('admin_email');
      const isPaid = document.getElementById('modal-payment-checkbox').checked;
      if (!adminEmail || !activeClientEmail) return;

      btn.disabled = true; btn.innerText = "Securing Files to Cloud...";

      try {
        let allFinalKeys = [...existingFinalFiles];

        for (let i = 0; i < newFinalFilesQueue.length; i++) {
          const fileObj = newFinalFilesQueue[i];
          btn.innerText = `Encrypting File ${i+1}/${newFinalFilesQueue.length}...`;
          
          const authRes = await fetch(API_URL, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('admin_access_token') }, body: JSON.stringify({ action: "getUploadUrl", fileName: "FINAL-" + fileObj.name, fileType: fileObj.type, userEmail: activeClientEmail }) });
          const authResult = await authRes.json();
          if (!authRes.ok || authResult.status !== 'SUCCESS') throw new Error("S3 Auth Failed");

          await fetch(authResult.uploadUrl, { method: 'PUT', headers: { 'Content-Type': fileObj.type }, body: fileObj });
          allFinalKeys.push({ fileName: "FINAL-" + fileObj.name, fileKey: authResult.fileKey });
        }

        btn.innerText = "Locking Database & Syncing Client...";
        const dbRes = await fetch(API_URL, {
          method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('admin_access_token') },
          body: JSON.stringify({ action: "updateBillingStatus", adminEmail: adminEmail, clientEmail: activeClientEmail, timestamp: activeClientTimestamp, finalFiles: allFinalKeys, paymentConfirmed: isPaid })
        });
        const dbResult = await dbRes.json();

        if (dbRes.ok && dbResult.status === 'SUCCESS') {
          alert(isPaid ? "Payment confirmed! Client has been emailed and their files are unlocked." : "Billing status and files updated successfully!");
          await showCRM(adminEmail); 
        } else { alert("Failed to update billing lock."); }

      } catch(err) { alert("Network error during billing lock."); } finally { btn.disabled = false; btn.innerText = "Save Billing & Notify Client"; }
    }

    async function sendEmailNudge(buttonElement) {
      const adminEmail = localStorage.getItem('admin_email');
      const clientName = document.getElementById('modal-client-name').innerText;
      const requestedDocName = document.getElementById('modal-request-doc').value;
      const spinner = document.getElementById('nudge-spinner');
      if (!adminEmail || !activeClientEmail || !requestedDocName) return;
      buttonElement.disabled = true; spinner.classList.remove('hidden');
      try {
        const response = await fetch(API_URL, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('admin_access_token') }, body: JSON.stringify({ action: "sendDocumentReminder", adminEmail: adminEmail, clientEmail: activeClientEmail, clientName: clientName, requestedDocName: requestedDocName }) });
        const result = await response.json();
        if (response.ok && result.status === 'SUCCESS') { alert(`Success! Email reminder sent to ${activeClientEmail}`); } else { alert("Reminder failed."); }
      } catch (err) { alert("Network error."); } finally { buttonElement.disabled = false; spinner.classList.add('hidden'); }
    }

    function sendWhatsAppNudge() {
      const clientName = document.getElementById('modal-client-name').innerText; const requestedDocName = document.getElementById('modal-request-doc').value;
      let phone = activeClientPhone;
      if (!phone || phone.length < 10) { phone = prompt("Client phone number missing. Please enter their 10-digit number:", ""); if (!phone) return; }
      const cleanPhone = "1" + phone.replace(/\D/g, "");
      const message = `Hi ${clientName}, Wasim Kadri, CPA here from FiscalX. We are actively preparing your tax file and require your "${requestedDocName}" to proceed. Please click this link to securely upload it: https://www.fiscalx.ca/dashboard/ Thank you!`;
      window.open(`https://wa.me/${cleanPhone}?text=${encodeURIComponent(message)}`, "_blank");
    }

    async function decryptAndDownload(fileKey, fileName, buttonElement) {
      const adminEmail = localStorage.getItem('admin_email'); if (!adminEmail || !fileKey) return;
      const originalText = buttonElement.innerText; buttonElement.disabled = true; buttonElement.innerText = "Decrypting...";
      try {
        const response = await fetch(API_URL, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('admin_access_token') }, body: JSON.stringify({ action: "getDownloadUrl", adminEmail: adminEmail, fileKey: fileKey }) });
        const result = await response.json();
        if (response.ok && result.status === 'SUCCESS') {
          const fileResponse = await fetch(result.secureUrl); const blob = await fileResponse.blob();
          if ('showSaveFilePicker' in window) { try { const handle = await window.showSaveFilePicker({ suggestedName: fileName }); const writable = await handle.createWritable(); await writable.write(blob); await writable.close(); } catch (e) { console.log("Cancelled"); } } else { const downloadUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob); const link = document.createElement('a'); link.href = downloadUrl; link.setAttribute('download', fileName); document.body.appendChild(link); link.click(); document.body.removeChild(link); URL.revokeObjectURL(downloadUrl); }
        } else { alert("Decryption failed."); }
      } catch (err) { alert("Network error."); } finally { buttonElement.disabled = false; buttonElement.innerText = originalText; }
    }

    async function updateClientStatus(newStatus) {
      const adminEmail = localStorage.getItem('admin_email'); const spinner = document.getElementById('status-update-spinner'); const dropdown = document.getElementById('modal-status-dropdown');
      if (!activeClientEmail || !activeClientTimestamp || !adminEmail) return;
      spinner.classList.remove('hidden'); dropdown.disabled = true;
      try {
        const response = await fetch(API_URL, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('admin_access_token') }, body: JSON.stringify({ action: "updateClientStatus", adminEmail: adminEmail, clientEmail: activeClientEmail, timestamp: activeClientTimestamp, newStatus: newStatus }) });
        const result = await response.json();
        if (response.ok && result.status === 'SUCCESS') { await showCRM(adminEmail); } else { alert("Error updating status."); }
      } catch (err) { alert("Network error updating status."); } finally { spinner.classList.add('hidden'); dropdown.disabled = false; }
    }

    async function updateClientAssignment(newAssignee) {
      const adminEmail = localStorage.getItem('admin_email'); 
      const spinner = document.getElementById('assign-update-spinner'); 
      const dropdown = document.getElementById('modal-assign-dropdown');
      
      if (!activeClientEmail || !activeClientTimestamp || !adminEmail) return;
      
      spinner.classList.remove('hidden'); dropdown.disabled = true;
      try {
        const response = await fetch(API_URL, { 
          method: 'POST', 
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('admin_access_token') }, 
          body: JSON.stringify({ 
            action: "updateClientAssignment", 
            adminEmail: adminEmail, 
            clientEmail: activeClientEmail, 
            timestamp: activeClientTimestamp, 
            assignedTo: newAssignee 
          }) 
        });
        const result = await response.json();
        if (response.ok && result.status === 'SUCCESS') { 
          await showCRM(adminEmail); 
        } else { 
          alert("Error updating assignment."); 
        }
      } catch (err) { 
        alert("Network error updating assignment."); 
      } finally {

      }
    }

    function toggleRescheduleForm(show) {
      const container = document.getElementById('reschedule-form-container');
      if (container) {
        if (show) {
          const dateInput = document.getElementById('admin-reschedule-date');
          if (dateInput) {
            const todayStr = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
            dateInput.setAttribute('min', todayStr);
            dateInput.onchange = (e) => {
              if (!e.target.value) return;
              const selectedDateObj = new Date(e.target.value);
              const dayOfWeek = new Date(selectedDateObj.getTime() + Math.abs(selectedDateObj.getTimezoneOffset() * 60000)).getDay();
              if (dayOfWeek === 0 || dayOfWeek === 6) {
                alert("Our office is closed on weekends. Please select a date between Monday and Friday.");
                e.target.value = ""; 
              }
            };
          }
          container.classList.remove('hidden');
        } else {
          container.classList.add('hidden');
        }
      }
    }

    async function submitAdminReschedule(btnElement) {
      const newDate = document.getElementById('admin-reschedule-date').value;
      const newTime = document.getElementById('admin-reschedule-time').value;
      
      if (!newDate || !newTime) { 
        alert("Please select both a Date and Time Slot!"); 
        return; 
      }

      const selectedDateObj = new Date(newDate);
      const dayOfWeek = new Date(selectedDateObj.getTime() + Math.abs(selectedDateObj.getTimezoneOffset() * 60000)).getDay();
      if (dayOfWeek === 0 || dayOfWeek === 6) {
        alert("Our office is closed on weekends. Please select a date between Monday and Friday.");
        document.getElementById('admin-reschedule-date').value = "";
        return;
      }

      const adminEmail = localStorage.getItem('admin_email');
      if (!adminEmail || !activeClientEmail || !activeClientTimestamp) return;

      btnElement.disabled = true; 
      btnElement.innerText = "Updating Cloud Schedule...";

      try {
        const response = await fetch(API_URL, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('admin_access_token') },
          body: JSON.stringify({ action: "rescheduleBooking", adminEmail: adminEmail, clientEmail: activeClientEmail, timestamp: activeClientTimestamp, newDate: newDate, newTime: newTime })
        });
        const result = await response.json();
        if (response.ok && result.status === 'SUCCESS') {
          alert(`🎉 Rescheduled to ${newDate} at ${newTime} EST! Client notified via automated email.`);
          closeModal();
          await showCRM(adminEmail);
        } else { alert("Failed to reschedule: " + (result.message || "Server error")); }
      } catch (err) { alert("Network error trying to reschedule appointment."); } 
      finally { btnElement.disabled = false; btnElement.innerText = "Save New Time & Email Client"; }
    }

    async function adminCancelAppointment() {
      if (!confirm("Are you sure you want to cancel this appointment? An automated notice will be emailed to the client.")) return;
      const adminEmail = localStorage.getItem('admin_email');
      if (!adminEmail || !activeClientEmail || !activeClientTimestamp) return;

      try {
        const response = await fetch(API_URL, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('admin_access_token') },
          body: JSON.stringify({ action: "cancelBooking", adminEmail: adminEmail, clientEmail: activeClientEmail, timestamp: activeClientTimestamp })
        });
        const result = await response.json();
        if (response.ok && result.status === 'SUCCESS') {
          alert("Appointment cancelled and client notified via email!");
          closeModal();
          await showCRM(adminEmail);
        } else { alert("Failed to cancel: " + (result.message || "Server error")); }
      } catch (err) { alert("Network error trying to cancel appointment."); }
    }

window.deleteClientCard = async function(btnElement) {
      if (!activeClientEmail) return;
      if (!confirm(`Are you sure you want to permanently delete the card for ${activeClientEmail}? This cannot be undone.`)) return;

      const adminEmail = localStorage.getItem('admin_email');
      if (!adminEmail) return;

      btnElement.disabled = true;
      btnElement.innerText = "Deleting...";

      try {
        const response = await fetch(API_URL, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('admin_access_token') },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            action: "deleteClient",
            adminEmail: adminEmail,
            clientEmail: activeClientEmail,
            timestamp: activeClientTimestamp
          })
        });

        const result = await response.json();
        if (response.ok && result.status === 'SUCCESS') {
          alert("✅ Record permanently deleted!");
          closeModal();
          await showCRM(adminEmail);
        } else {
          alert("Error deleting record: " + (result.message || "Server error"));
        }
      } catch (err) {
        alert("Network error trying to delete record.");
      } finally {
        btnElement.disabled = false;
        btnElement.innerText = "🗑️ Delete Record";
      }
    };

    // ==============================================================
    // QUICKBOOKS CASH RECOVERY LOGIC
    // ==============================================================
    async function fetchAndRenderInvoices() {
        const adminEmail = localStorage.getItem('admin_email');
        if (!adminEmail) return;

        const listDiv = document.getElementById('qbo-invoice-list');
        const totalDiv = document.getElementById('qbo-total-unpaid');
        const commDiv = document.getElementById('qbo-commission');
        
        listDiv.innerHTML = "<p class='text-xs text-green-400 font-bold animate-pulse'>Securely fetching live QuickBooks data...</p>";

        try {
            const response = await fetch(API_URL, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('admin_access_token') },
                body: JSON.stringify({ action: "fetchQboInvoices", adminEmail: adminEmail })
            });
            const result = await response.json();

            if (response.ok && result.status === 'SUCCESS') {
                const invoices = result.invoices || [];
                if (invoices.length === 0) {
                    listDiv.innerHTML = "<div class='p-3 bg-green-500/10 border border-green-500/20 rounded-xl'><p class='text-xs font-bold text-green-400'>✅ All clients are paid up! Zero outstanding invoices.</p></div>";
                    totalDiv.innerText = "$0.00";
                    commDiv.innerText = "$0.00";
                    return;
                }

                // Sort invoices from oldest to youngest (ascending by DueDate)
                invoices.sort((a, b) => {
                    const dateA = a.DueDate ? new Date(a.DueDate).getTime() : Date.now();
                    const dateB = b.DueDate ? new Date(b.DueDate).getTime() : Date.now();
                    return dateA - dateB;
                });

                let totalUnpaid = 0;
                let commissionableUnpaid = 0;
                listDiv.innerHTML = "";

                invoices.forEach(inv => {
                    const balance = parseFloat(inv.Balance || 0);
                    
                    const customerName = inv.CustomerRef ? inv.CustomerRef.name : "Unknown Client";
                    const docNumber = inv.DocNumber || "N/A";
                    const dueDate = inv.DueDate || "N/A";
                    
                    const customerEmail = inv.BillEmail ? inv.BillEmail.Address : "";
                    const customerPhone = inv.PrimaryPhone ? inv.PrimaryPhone.FreeFormNumber : "";
                    const safeName = customerName.replace(/'/g, "\\'");

                    // THE MEMORY: Read the ledger data injected by our backend
                    const ledger = inv._ledger || { escalationLevel: 0, lastContactDate: "Never", isPaused: false };
                    
                    // Check if eligible for commission (Level 1: >= 30 days past due OR already escalated)
                    let isCommissionable = ledger.escalationLevel > 0;
                    if (!isCommissionable && dueDate !== "N/A") {
                        const today = new Date();
                        const due = new Date(dueDate);
                        const daysSinceDue = (today.getTime() - due.getTime()) / (1000 * 3600 * 24);
                        if (daysSinceDue >= 30) isCommissionable = true;
                    }
                    
                    // ONLY SHOW INVOICES >= 30 DAYS PAST DUE
                    if (!isCommissionable) return;

                    totalUnpaid += balance;
                    commissionableUnpaid += balance;

                    const pauseText = ledger.isPaused ? "▶️ Resume Auto" : "⏸️ Pause Auto";
                    const pauseBtnClass = ledger.isPaused ? "bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-400 border-amber-500/30 hover:bg-amber-500 hover:text-slate-900" : "bg-slate-500/10 text-slate-400 border-slate-500/30 hover:bg-slate-500 hover:text-white";
                    const rowOpacity = ledger.isPaused ? "opacity-50 grayscale" : ""; 
                    const reminderDisabled = ledger.isPaused ? "disabled" : "";
                    const reminderClass = ledger.isPaused ? "bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 border-slate-700 cursor-not-allowed" : "bg-red-500/10 text-red-400 border-red-500/20 hover:bg-red-500 hover:text-white";
                    const smsClass = ledger.isPaused ? "bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 border-slate-700 cursor-not-allowed" : "bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-400 border-blue-500/20 hover:bg-blue-500 hover:text-white";

                    listDiv.innerHTML += `
                        <div class="flex justify-between items-center bg-[#131A2B] border border-white/5 p-3.5 rounded-xl hover:border-green-500/30 transition-all ${rowOpacity}">
                            <div>
                                <p class="text-sm font-bold text-slate-200">${customerName} <span class="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-500 ml-2 bg-black/40 px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-white/10">Inv #${docNumber}</span></p>
                                <p class="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-semibold mt-1.5 flex items-center gap-2">
                                    <span class="text-red-400">Due: ${dueDate}</span> 
                                    <span class="text-slate-600">|</span> 
                                    <span class="text-green-400">Last Alert: ${ledger.lastContactDate} (Level ${ledger.escalationLevel})</span>
                                </p>
                            </div>
                            <div class="text-right flex flex-col items-end">
                                <p class="text-sm font-black text-slate-100 mb-1.5">$${balance.toFixed(2)}</p>
                                <div class="flex gap-2">
                                    <button onclick="toggleInvoicePause('${docNumber}', ${ledger.isPaused}, this)" class="text-[9px] uppercase tracking-wider font-bold px-2 py-1.5 border rounded-lg transition shadow-sm ${pauseBtnClass}">
                                        ${pauseText}
                                    </button>
                                    <button ${reminderDisabled} onclick="sendQboReminderEmail('${customerEmail}', '${safeName}', '${balance}', '${docNumber}', this)" class="text-[9px] uppercase tracking-wider font-bold px-2.5 py-1.5 border rounded-lg transition shadow-sm ${reminderClass}">
                                        Send Email
                                    </button>
                                    <button ${reminderDisabled} onclick="sendQboSmsReminder('${customerPhone}', '${safeName}', '${balance}', '${docNumber}', this)" class="text-[9px] uppercase tracking-wider font-bold px-2.5 py-1.5 border rounded-lg transition shadow-sm ${smsClass}">
                                        Send SMS
                                    </button>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    `;
                });

                totalDiv.innerText = "$" + totalUnpaid.toFixed(2) + " CAD";
                commDiv.innerText = "$" + (commissionableUnpaid * 0.05).toFixed(2) + " CAD";

            } else {
                if (result.message && result.message.includes("not connected")) {
                    listDiv.innerHTML = "<p class='text-xs text-amber-500 font-bold'>⚠️ QuickBooks is not connected. Please click 'Connect QBO' at the top of the screen.</p>";
                } else {
                    listDiv.innerHTML = `<p class='text-xs text-red-500'>Error: ${result.message}</p>`;
                }
            }
        } catch (err) {
            listDiv.innerHTML = "<p class='text-xs text-red-500 font-bold'>Network error fetching QuickBooks data.</p>";
        }
    }

// ==============================================================
    // ACTION: GENERATE COMMISSION REPORT & RESET METER
    // ==============================================================
    window.generateCommissionReport = async function(btnElement) {
        const adminEmail = localStorage.getItem('admin_email');
        if (!adminEmail) return;

        // --- MASTER SECURITY LOCK ---
        const passcode = prompt("🔐 SECURE ACCESS: Please enter the Master Admin PIN to view commissions:");
        if (passcode !== "0224") { 
            alert("❌ Access Denied: Incorrect PIN.");
            return;
            } // --- END MASTER SECURITY LOCK ---

        const originalText = btnElement.innerHTML;
        btnElement.disabled = true;
        btnElement.innerHTML = "⏳ Calculating...";

        try {
            const response = await fetch(API_URL, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('admin_access_token') },
                body: JSON.stringify({ action: "generateCommissionReport", adminEmail: adminEmail })
            });
            const result = await response.json();

            if (response.ok && result.status === 'SUCCESS') {
                if (result.recoveredCash > 0) {
                    const confirmReset = confirm(`💰 COMMISSION REPORT\n\nTotal Invoices Recovered by System: ${result.recoveredCount}\nTotal Cash Recovered: $${result.recoveredCash.toFixed(2)} CAD\n\nYour 5% Commission Earned: $${result.yourCommission.toFixed(2)} CAD\n\nWould you like to mark this commission as PAID and reset the meter to $0.00 for next month?`);
                    
                    if (confirmReset) {
                        btnElement.innerHTML = "🧹 Resetting Meter...";
                        await fetch(API_URL, {
                            method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('admin_access_token') },
                            body: JSON.stringify({ action: "markCommissionPaid", adminEmail: adminEmail, paidDocNumbers: result.paidDocNumbers })
                        });
                        alert("✅ Commission meter successfully reset! Next month's tracking begins now.");
                    }
                } else {
                    alert(`💰 COMMISSION REPORT\n\nTotal Invoices Recovered by System: ${result.recoveredCount}\nTotal Cash Recovered: $${result.recoveredCash.toFixed(2)} CAD\n\nYour 5% Commission Earned: $${result.yourCommission.toFixed(2)} CAD`);
                }
            } else {
                alert("Error generating report: " + (result.message || "Server error"));
            }
        } catch (err) {
            alert("Network error generating report.");
        } finally {
            btnElement.disabled = false;
            btnElement.innerHTML = originalText;
        }
    };
    
    // ==============================================================
    // ACTION T: SEND REMINDER EMAIL FUNCTION
    // ==============================================================
    window.sendQboReminderEmail = async function(customerEmail, customerName, balance, docNumber, btnElement) {
        if (!customerEmail) {
            alert("Error: This client does not have an email address saved in QuickBooks.");
            return;
        }

        const adminEmail = localStorage.getItem('admin_email');
        if (!adminEmail) return;

        const originalText = btnElement.innerText;
        btnElement.disabled = true;
        btnElement.innerText = "Sending...";

        try {
            const response = await fetch(API_URL, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('admin_access_token') },
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    action: "sendQboReminder",
                    adminEmail: adminEmail,
                    customerEmail: customerEmail,
                    customerName: customerName,
                    balance: balance,
                    docNumber: docNumber
                })
            });

            const result = await response.json();
            if (response.ok && result.status === 'SUCCESS') {
                alert(`✅ Reminder successfully emailed to ${customerEmail}`);
                btnElement.innerText = "Sent!";
                btnElement.classList.remove('text-red-400', 'border-red-500/20', 'bg-red-500/10', 'hover:bg-red-500');
                btnElement.classList.add('text-green-400', 'border-green-500/20', 'bg-green-500/10', 'cursor-not-allowed');
            } else {
                alert("Error sending reminder: " + (result.message || "Server error"));
                btnElement.innerText = originalText;
                btnElement.disabled = false;
            }
        } catch (err) {
            alert("Network error trying to send reminder.");
            btnElement.innerText = originalText;
            btnElement.disabled = false;
        }
    };

// ==============================================================

                    action: "sendQboSmsReminder",

            });

                alert("Error sending SMS: " + (result.message || "Server error"));
                btnElement.innerText = originalText;
                btnElement.disabled = false;
            }
        } catch (err) {
            alert("Network error trying to send SMS.");
            btnElement.innerText = originalText;

        }
    };

    // ==============================================================
    // ACTION V: TOGGLE INVOICE KILL SWITCH (PAUSE AUTOMATION)
    // ==============================================================
    window.toggleInvoicePause = async function(docNumber, isCurrentlyPaused, btnElement) {
        const adminEmail = localStorage.getItem('admin_email');
        if (!adminEmail) return;

        btnElement.disabled = true;
        btnElement.innerText = "Saving...";

        try {
            const response = await fetch(API_URL, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('admin_access_token') },
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    action: "toggleInvoicePause",
                    adminEmail: adminEmail,
                    docNumber: docNumber,
                    isPaused: !isCurrentlyPaused // Flip the boolean
                })
            });

            const result = await response.json();
            if (response.ok && result.status === 'SUCCESS') {
                // Instantly re-fetch the invoices to reflect the new visual state
                fetchAndRenderInvoices();
            } else {
                alert("Error updating automation status: " + (result.message || "Server error"));
                btnElement.disabled = false;
            }
        } catch (err) {
            alert("Network error trying to update automation status.");
            btnElement.disabled = false;
        }
    };

    function showLogin() { localStorage.removeItem('admin_id_token'); localStorage.removeItem('admin_email'); crmScreen.classList.add('hidden'); loginScreen.classList.remove('hidden'); }

    function showLogin() { localStorage.removeItem('admin_id_token'); localStorage.removeItem('admin_email'); crmScreen.classList.add('hidden'); loginScreen.classList.remove('hidden'); }

    loginForm.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
      e.preventDefault(); const email = document.getElementById('admin-email-input').value.trim(); const password = document.getElementById('admin-password-input').value; const submitBtn = loginForm.querySelector('button');
      submitBtn.disabled = true; submitBtn.innerText = "Authenticating...";
      try {
        const response = await fetch(`https://cognito-idp.${COGNITO_REGION}.amazonaws.com/`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-amz-json-1.1', 'X-Amz-Target': 'AWSCognitoIdentityProviderService.InitiateAuth' }, body: JSON.stringify({ AuthFlow: "USER_PASSWORD_AUTH", ClientId: COGNITO_CLIENT_ID, AuthParameters: { USERNAME: email, PASSWORD: password } }) });
        let result = await response.json();
        if (response.ok && result.ChallengeName === 'NEW_PASSWORD_REQUIRED') {
          const newPassword = prompt("First-Time Sign-In: Please choose a secure permanent password:");
          if (!newPassword) { submitBtn.disabled = false; submitBtn.innerText = "Secure Login"; return; }
          submitBtn.innerText = "Setting Permanent Password...";
          const challengeResponse = await fetch(`https://cognito-idp.${COGNITO_REGION}.amazonaws.com/`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-amz-json-1.1', 'X-Amz-Target': 'AWSCognitoIdentityProviderService.RespondToAuthChallenge' }, body: JSON.stringify({ ChallengeName: "NEW_PASSWORD_REQUIRED", ClientId: COGNITO_CLIENT_ID, Session: result.Session, ChallengeResponses: { USERNAME: email, NEW_PASSWORD: newPassword, "userAttributes.name": "Staff Member" } }) });
          result = await challengeResponse.json();
        }
        if (result.AuthenticationResult) {
          const idToken = result.AuthenticationResult.IdToken; const payload = parseJwt(idToken); const groups = payload ? payload['cognito:groups'] || [] : [];
          if (!groups.includes('Staff')) { alert("Access Denied."); submitBtn.disabled = false; submitBtn.innerText = "Secure Login"; return; }
          localStorage.setItem('admin_id_token', idToken); localStorage.setItem('admin_email', email); showCRM(email);
        } else { alert('Login failed.'); }
      } catch (err) { alert('Network error.'); } finally { submitBtn.disabled = false; submitBtn.innerText = "Secure Login"; }
    });
    logoutBtn.addEventListener('click', showLogin);
  </script>
</body>
</html>

<file path="backend/index.mjs">
import { S3Client, PutObjectCommand, GetObjectCommand } from "@aws-sdk/client-s3";
import { getSignedUrl } from "@aws-sdk/s3-request-presigner";
import { SESClient, SendEmailCommand } from "@aws-sdk/client-ses";
import { SNSClient, PublishCommand } from "@aws-sdk/client-sns";
import { DynamoDBClient } from "@aws-sdk/client-dynamodb";
import { DynamoDBDocumentClient, PutCommand, ScanCommand, UpdateCommand, DeleteCommand, GetCommand } from "@aws-sdk/lib-dynamodb";
import { CognitoIdentityProviderClient, AdminListGroupsForUserCommand, GetUserCommand } from "@aws-sdk/client-cognito-identity-provider";
import { BedrockRuntimeClient, InvokeModelCommand } from "@aws-sdk/client-bedrock-runtime";

const s3 = new S3Client({ region: "ca-central-1" });
const ses = new SESClient({ region: "ca-central-1" });
const sns = new SNSClient({ region: "ca-central-1" });
const ddbClient = new DynamoDBClient({ region: "ca-central-1" });
const ddbDocClient = DynamoDBDocumentClient.from(ddbClient);
const cognito = new CognitoIdentityProviderClient({ region: "ca-central-1" });
const bedrock = new BedrockRuntimeClient({ region: "ca-central-1" });

const BUCKET_NAME = "fiscalx-document-vault-673098723249";
const TABLE_NAME = "fiscalx-client-onboarding";
const USER_POOL_ID = "ca-central-1_omKzLVfdI"; 
const SENDER_EMAIL = "info@fiscalx.ca"; 
const OFFICE_EMAIL = "info@fiscalx.ca"; 
const MS_CLIENT_ID = "359dc7f8-359d-47ab-abcf-c0129559aacb";
const MS_TENANT_ID = "8793dd74-ad92-4663-a197-95c9e0955c5e";
const MS_CLIENT_SECRET = process.env.MS_CLIENT_SECRET; 
const MS_REDIRECT_URI = "https://www.fiscalx.ca/admin/";

const QBO_CLIENT_ID = "ABpC4zd9xPXxZkN9AgXd8mGM2EvvT1Uiw1bt9BvUJHBRxvoXex"; 
const QBO_CLIENT_SECRET = process.env.QBO_CLIENT_SECRET; 
const QBO_REDIRECT_URI = "https://fiscalx.ca/admin/";

const AUTHORIZED_STAFF = [
    "wasim@fiscalx.ca",

async function isStaff(email, accessToken) {
    if (!email) return false;
    try {
        const command = new AdminListGroupsForUserCommand({
            UserPoolId: USER_POOL_ID,
            Username: email.trim()
        });
        const result = await cognito.send(command);
        const groups = (result.Groups || []).map(g => g.GroupName);
        return groups.includes("Staff");
    } catch (err) {
        console.error(`Cognito group check failed for ${email}:`, err);
        return false;
    }
}

async function getMsAccessToken() {
    try {
        const configRes = await ddbDocClient.send(new ScanCommand({
            TableName: TABLE_NAME,
            FilterExpression: "userEmail = :e AND #ts = :t",
            ExpressionAttributeNames: { "#ts": "timestamp" },
            ExpressionAttributeValues: { ":e": "SYSTEM_CONFIG", ":t": "MICROSOFT_OUTLOOK_AUTH" }
        }));
        const configItem = (configRes.Items || [])[0];
        if (!configItem || !configItem.msRefreshToken) return null;

        const tokenRes = await fetch(`https://login.microsoftonline.com/common/oauth2/v2.0/token`, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
            body: new URLSearchParams({
                client_id: MS_CLIENT_ID,
                client_secret: MS_CLIENT_SECRET,
                refresh_token: configItem.msRefreshToken,
                grant_type: 'refresh_token'
            })
        });
        const tokenData = await tokenRes.json();
        return tokenData.access_token || null;
    } catch (err) {
        console.error("Microsoft Token Refresh Error:", err);
        return null;
    }
}

async function getQboAccessToken() {
    try {
        const configRes = await ddbDocClient.send(new ScanCommand({
            TableName: TABLE_NAME,
            FilterExpression: "userEmail = :e AND #ts = :t",
            ExpressionAttributeNames: { "#ts": "timestamp" },
            ExpressionAttributeValues: { ":e": "SYSTEM_CONFIG", ":t": "QUICKBOOKS_AUTH" }
        }));
        const configItem = (configRes.Items || [])[0];
        if (!configItem || !configItem.qboRefreshToken) return null;

        const authHeader = Buffer.from(`${QBO_CLIENT_ID}:${QBO_CLIENT_SECRET}`).toString('base64');

        const tokenRes = await fetch(`https://oauth.platform.intuit.com/oauth2/v1/tokens/bearer`, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 
                'Accept': 'application/json',
                'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
                'Authorization': `Basic ${authHeader}`
            },
            body: new URLSearchParams({
                grant_type: 'refresh_token',
                refresh_token: configItem.qboRefreshToken
            })
        });
        
        const tokenData = await tokenRes.json();
        if (!tokenData.access_token) throw new Error("QBO Token Refresh Failed");

        await ddbDocClient.send(new UpdateCommand({
            TableName: TABLE_NAME,
            Key: { "userEmail": "SYSTEM_CONFIG", "timestamp": "QUICKBOOKS_AUTH" },
            UpdateExpression: "set qboRefreshToken = :r, updatedAt = :u",
            ExpressionAttributeValues: { ":r": tokenData.refresh_token, ":u": new Date().toISOString() }
        }));

        return { accessToken: tokenData.access_token, realmId: configItem.qboRealmId || "UNKNOWN" };
    } catch (err) {
        console.error("QuickBooks Token Refresh Error:", err);
        return null;
    }
}

async function getQboPhoneDirectory(baseUrl, qboAuth) {
    try {
        const custQuery = encodeURIComponent(`select Id, PrimaryPhone, Mobile from Customer MAXRESULTS 1000`);
        const custRes = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/v3/company/${qboAuth.realmId}/query?query=${custQuery}&minorversion=65`, {
            method: 'GET', headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${qboAuth.accessToken}`, 'Accept': 'application/json' }
        });
        const custData = await custRes.json();
        const customers = custData?.QueryResponse?.Customer || [];
        const phoneDirectory = {};
        for (const c of customers) {
            const phone = c.PrimaryPhone?.FreeFormNumber || c.Mobile?.FreeFormNumber;
            if (phone) phoneDirectory[c.Id] = phone;
        }
        return phoneDirectory;
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Failed to fetch QBO customer directory:", e);
        return {};
    }
}

export const handler = async (event) => {
    console.log("Incoming Event Payload:", JSON.stringify(event));
    console.log("DIAGNOSTIC - QBO ID:", QBO_CLIENT_ID, "QBO SECRET Length:", QBO_CLIENT_SECRET ? QBO_CLIENT_SECRET.length : "MISSING/UNDEFINED");

    const headers = {
        "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
        "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Content-Type",
        "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "OPTIONS,POST"
    };

    if (event.requestContext && event.requestContext.httpMethod === "OPTIONS") {
        return { statusCode: 200, headers: headers, body: JSON.stringify({ message: "CORS preflight successful" }) };
    }

    try {
        const data = event.body ? JSON.parse(event.body) : event;
        const authHeader = (event.headers && (event.headers['authorization'] || event.headers['Authorization'])) || "";
        const accessToken = authHeader.replace("Bearer ", "").trim();

        if (data.action === "getUploadUrl") {
            const fileName = data.fileName;
            const fileType = data.fileType;
            const userEmail = data.userEmail;

            const fileKey = `clients/${userEmail}/${Date.now()}-${fileName}`;
            const command = new PutObjectCommand({ Bucket: BUCKET_NAME, Key: fileKey, ContentType: fileType });
            const uploadUrl = await getSignedUrl(s3, command, { expiresIn: 300 });

            return { statusCode: 200, headers: headers, body: JSON.stringify({ status: "SUCCESS", uploadUrl: uploadUrl, fileKey: fileKey }) };
        }

        if (data.action === "notifyUploadComplete") {
            const fileKey = data.fileKey;
            const userEmail = data.userEmail;
            const fileName = fileKey.split("/").pop(); 
            const cleanFileName = fileName.substring(13); 

            try {
                const scanParams = {
                    TableName: TABLE_NAME,
                    FilterExpression: "userEmail = :email",
                    ExpressionAttributeValues: { ":email": userEmail }
                };
                const scanResult = await ddbDocClient.send(new ScanCommand(scanParams));
                const userRecords = scanResult.Items || [];

                if (userRecords.length > 0) {
                    userRecords.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.timestamp) - new Date(a.timestamp));
                    const latestRecord = userRecords[0];
                    const existingFiles = latestRecord.uploadedFiles || [];
                    
                    if (!existingFiles.some(f => f.fileKey === fileKey)) {
                        existingFiles.push({ fileName: cleanFileName, fileKey: fileKey });
                        await ddbDocClient.send(new UpdateCommand({
                            TableName: TABLE_NAME,
                            Key: { userEmail: latestRecord.userEmail, timestamp: latestRecord.timestamp },
                            UpdateExpression: "set uploadedFiles = :f",
                            ExpressionAttributeValues: { ":f": existingFiles }
                        }));
                    }
                }
            } catch (dbError) {
                console.error("Failed to automatically link S3 upload to DynamoDB record:", dbError);
            }

            const downloadCommand = new GetObjectCommand({ Bucket: BUCKET_NAME, Key: fileKey });
            const downloadUrl = await getSignedUrl(s3, downloadCommand, { expiresIn: 86400 });

            const emailHtml = `
                <div style="font-family: sans-serif; padding: 20px; color: #1e293b; background-color: #f8fafc; border-radius: 16px; max-width: 600px; margin: 0 auto; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;">
                    <h2 style="color: #4f46e5; margin-bottom: 4px;">FiscalX Document Vault</h2>
                    <p style="font-size: 14px; color: #64748b; margin-top: 0;">Automated Client Upload Notification</p>
                    <hr style="border: 0; border-top: 1px solid #e2e8f0; margin: 20px 0;">
                    <p style="font-size: 15px;">Hello Administrative Team,</p>
                    <p style="font-size: 15px;">A client has successfully uploaded a new document to their secure private folder:</p>
                    <table style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin: 20px 0; font-size: 14px; background-color: #ffffff; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;">
                        <tr><td style="padding: 12px; font-weight: bold; color: #475569; width: 140px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0;">Client Email:</td><td style="padding: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0;">${userEmail}</td></tr>
                        <tr><td style="padding: 12px; font-weight: bold; color: #475569; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0;">File Name:</td><td style="padding: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0;">${cleanFileName}</td></tr>
                    </table>
                    <div style="text-align: center; margin: 30px 0;">
                        <a href="${downloadUrl}" target="_blank" style="background-color: #4f46e5; color: #ffffff; text-decoration: none; padding: 14px 28px; font-weight: bold; font-size: 14px; border-radius: 8px;">Download Document Securely</a>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;

            await ses.send(new SendEmailCommand({
                Source: SENDER_EMAIL, Destination: { ToAddresses: [OFFICE_EMAIL] },
                Message: { Subject: { Charset: "UTF-8", Data: `[Vault Alert] New Client Upload from ${userEmail}` }, Body: { Html: { Charset: "UTF-8", Data: emailHtml } } }
            }));

            return { statusCode: 200, headers: headers, body: JSON.stringify({ status: "SUCCESS" }) };
        }

        if (data.action === "submitTaxOrganizer") {
            const {
                userEmail = "Unknown", taxType = "T1 Personal", craConsent = "Not Provided", howHeard = "Not Specified",
                personalInfo = {}, familyMembers = [], statusInCanada = {}, ontarioResidency = [], milestones = {},
                selfEmployed = {}, rentalIncome = {}, childCareBenefit = {}, corporateInfo = {}, notes = "None provided.", uploadedFiles = [] 
            } = data;

            const isT2 = taxType.includes("T2");
            const combinedName = isT2 ? corporateInfo.corpName : `${personalInfo.firstName || ""} ${personalInfo.middleName || ""} ${personalInfo.lastName || ""}`.trim();
            const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();

            // 1. BUILD THE EXCEL/CSV DATA
            const csvRows = [ ["Section", "Field", "Value"] ];
            csvRows.push(["System", "Tax Type", taxType], ["System", "CRA Consent", craConsent], ["System", "Client Email", userEmail], ["System", "Client Notes", notes], ["System", "How Heard", howHeard]);

            if (isT2) {
                csvRows.push(
                    ["T2 Corporate", "Corporate Name", corporateInfo.corpName || "N/A"], ["T2 Corporate", "Business Number", corporateInfo.businessNumber || "N/A"],
                    ["T2 Corporate", "Date of Incorporation", corporateInfo.incDate || "N/A"], ["T2 Corporate", "Fiscal Year End", corporateInfo.fiscalYearEnd || "N/A"],
                    ["T2 Corporate", "Bookkeeping Software", corporateInfo.software || "N/A"], ["T2 Corporate", "Primary Industry", corporateInfo.industry || "N/A"],
                    ["T2 Remittance", "GST/HST Registered", corporateInfo.remittance?.gst || "no"], ["T2 Remittance", "Payroll Registered", corporateInfo.remittance?.payroll || "no"]
                );
                if (corporateInfo.directors && corporateInfo.directors.length > 0) {
                    corporateInfo.directors.forEach((d, index) => { csvRows.push(["Director " + (index + 1), "Name", d.name], ["Director " + (index + 1), "SIN", d.sin], ["Director " + (index + 1), "Share %", d.share], ["Director " + (index + 1), "Role", d.role]); });
                }
            } else {
                csvRows.push(
                    ["T1 Personal", "Full Name", combinedName || "N/A"], ["T1 Personal", "SIN", personalInfo.sin || "N/A"], ["T1 Personal", "Telephone", personalInfo.telephone || "N/A"], ["T1 Personal", "Address", personalInfo.address || "N/A"], ["T1 Personal", "US Citizen", personalInfo.usCitizen || "N/A"], ["T1 Personal", "Marital Status", personalInfo.maritalStatus || "N/A"], ["T1 Personal", "Spousal Income ($)", personalInfo.spousalIncome || "0.00"],
                    ["T1 Status", "Immigration Status", statusInCanada.status || "N/A"], ["T1 Status", "Entry Date", statusInCanada.entryDate || "N/A"]
                );
            }
            
            // 2. SAVE CSV DIRECTLY TO S3
            const csvString = csvRows.map(row => row.map(cell => `"${(cell||'').toString().replace(/"/g, '""')}"`).join(',')).join('\n');
            const csvKey = `clients/${userEmail}/${Date.now()}-${taxType.substring(0,2)}-Organizer.csv`;
            await s3.send(new PutObjectCommand({ Bucket: BUCKET_NAME, Key: csvKey, Body: csvString, ContentType: "text/csv" }));
            
            // 3. INJECT THE CSV INTO THE KANBAN VAULT
            const allFiles = [...uploadedFiles];
            allFiles.push({ fileName: `[Data] ${taxType} Organizer.csv`, fileKey: csvKey });

            // 4. SAVE EVERYTHING TO DYNAMODB
            await ddbDocClient.send(new PutCommand({
                TableName: TABLE_NAME,
                Item: {
                    userEmail: userEmail, timestamp: timestamp, taxType: taxType, craConsent: craConsent, clientName: combinedName,
                    amountOwed: "0.00", amountCollected: "0.00", campaignStatus: "Pending", howHeard: howHeard, notes: notes,
                    uploadedFiles: allFiles, personalInfo: personalInfo, corporateInfo: corporateInfo, statusInCanada: statusInCanada,
                    familyMembers: familyMembers, ontarioResidency: ontarioResidency, milestones: milestones, selfEmployed: selfEmployed,
                    rentalIncome: rentalIncome, childCareBenefit: childCareBenefit,
                    paymentConfirmed: false, finalFiles: []
                }
            }));

            // 5. BUILD THE "GOD VIEW" EMAIL
            let godViewHtml = `<table style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 15px; font-size: 13px;">`;
            // Skip the header row (index 0) and loop through all data
            for (let i = 1; i < csvRows.length; i++) {
                godViewHtml += `<tr>
                    <td style="padding: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; font-weight: bold; color: #475569; width: 40%;">${csvRows[i][1]}:</td>
                    <td style="padding: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; color: #0f172a;">${csvRows[i][2]}</td>
                </tr>`;
            }
            godViewHtml += `</table>`;

            // Build a permanent, non-expiring link that points to the CRM dashboard
            const permanentDownloadLink = `https://www.fiscalx.ca/admin/`;

            const organizerHtml = `
                <div style="font-family: sans-serif; padding: 20px; color: #1e293b; background-color: #f8fafc; border-radius: 16px; max-width: 650px; margin: 0 auto; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;">
                    <h2 style="color: #059669; margin-bottom: 4px;">FiscalX Professional Portal</h2>
                    <p style="font-size: 14px; color: #64748b; margin-top: 0;">Completed Tax Organizer (${taxType})</p>
                    
                    <div style="margin-top: 20px; padding: 15px; background-color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 8px;">
                        <h3 style="margin-top: 0; color: #0f172a; font-size: 15px; border-bottom: 2px solid #059669; padding-bottom: 5px;">God View: Client Submission Data</h3>
                        ${godViewHtml}
                    </div>

                    <div style="margin-top: 25px; padding: 15px; background-color: #fef3c7; border: 1px solid #fde68a; border-radius: 8px;">
                        <p style="font-size: 13px; color: #92400e; margin: 0;"><strong>${allFiles.length - 1} PDF/Image Documents</strong> were securely uploaded by the client.</p>
                        <p style="font-size: 13px; color: #92400e; margin-top: 5px;">The complete Excel CSV file has also been generated.</p>
                    </div>

                    <div style="text-align: center; margin: 30px 0;">
                        <a href="${permanentDownloadLink}" target="_blank" style="background-color: #059669; color: #ffffff; text-decoration: none; padding: 14px 28px; font-weight: bold; font-size: 14px; border-radius: 8px;">📂 Open CRM to Download Files & Excel</a>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;

            await ses.send(new SendEmailCommand({
                Source: SENDER_EMAIL, Destination: { ToAddresses: [OFFICE_EMAIL] },
                Message: { Subject: { Charset: "UTF-8", Data: `[${taxType}] Complete Onboarding from ${combinedName || userEmail}` }, Body: { Html: { Charset: "UTF-8", Data: organizerHtml } } }
            }));

            return { statusCode: 200, headers: headers, body: JSON.stringify({ status: "SUCCESS", message: "Your onboarding organizer and files have been securely compiled and delivered." }) };
        }

        if (data.action === "getCrmData") {
            const adminEmail = data.adminEmail;

            const isAuthorized = await isStaff(adminEmail, accessToken);
            if (!isAuthorized) return { statusCode: 403, headers: headers, body: JSON.stringify({ status: "ERROR", message: "Unauthorized." }) };

            const scanResult = await ddbDocClient.send(new ScanCommand({ TableName: TABLE_NAME }));
            const clients = (scanResult.Items || []).filter(c => c.userEmail !== "SYSTEM_CONFIG" && !c.userEmail.includes("QBO_INVOICE#"));

            const total = clients.length;
            const inProgress = clients.filter(c => c.campaignStatus === 'Pending' || c.campaignStatus === 'In Progress').length;
            const completed = clients.filter(c => c.campaignStatus === 'Completed').length;

            return { statusCode: 200, headers: headers, body: JSON.stringify({ status: "SUCCESS", stats: { total, inProgress, completed }, clients: clients }) };
        }

        if (data.action === "updateClientStatus") {
            const adminEmail = data.adminEmail;
            const clientEmail = data.clientEmail;
            const clientTimestamp = data.timestamp;
            const newStatus = data.newStatus;

            const isAuthorized = await isStaff(adminEmail, accessToken);
            if (!isAuthorized) return { statusCode: 403, headers: headers, body: JSON.stringify({ status: "ERROR", message: "Unauthorized." }) };

            try {
                await ddbDocClient.send(new UpdateCommand({
                    TableName: TABLE_NAME,
                    Key: { "userEmail": String(clientEmail), "timestamp": String(clientTimestamp) },
                    UpdateExpression: "set campaignStatus = :s",
                    ExpressionAttributeValues: { ":s": String(newStatus) }
                }));
                return { statusCode: 200, headers: headers, body: JSON.stringify({ status: "SUCCESS", message: "Status updated successfully." }) };
            } catch (updateError) {
                return { statusCode: 400, headers: headers, body: JSON.stringify({ status: "ERROR", message: updateError.message }) };
            }
        }

        if (data.action === "updateClientAssignment") {
            const adminEmail = data.adminEmail;
            const clientEmail = data.clientEmail;
            const clientTimestamp = data.timestamp;
            const assignedTo = data.assignedTo;

            const isAuthorized = await isStaff(adminEmail, accessToken);
            if (!isAuthorized) return { statusCode: 403, headers: headers, body: JSON.stringify({ status: "ERROR", message: "Unauthorized." }) };

            try {
                await ddbDocClient.send(new UpdateCommand({
                    TableName: TABLE_NAME,
                    Key: { "userEmail": String(clientEmail), "timestamp": String(clientTimestamp) },
                    UpdateExpression: "set assignedTo = :a",
                    ExpressionAttributeValues: { ":a": String(assignedTo) }
                }));
                return { statusCode: 200, headers: headers, body: JSON.stringify({ status: "SUCCESS", message: "Assignment updated successfully." }) };
            } catch (updateError) {
                return { statusCode: 400, headers: headers, body: JSON.stringify({ status: "ERROR", message: updateError.message }) };
            }
        }

        if (data.action === "getDownloadUrl") {
            const isAuthorized = await isStaff(data.adminEmail, accessToken);
            if (!isAuthorized) return { statusCode: 403, headers: headers, body: JSON.stringify({ status: "ERROR" }) };

            try {
                const downloadCommand = new GetObjectCommand({ Bucket: BUCKET_NAME, Key: data.fileKey });
                const secureUrl = await getSignedUrl(s3, downloadCommand, { expiresIn: 60 });
                return { statusCode: 200, headers: headers, body: JSON.stringify({ status: "SUCCESS", secureUrl: secureUrl }) };
            } catch (s3Error) {
                return { statusCode: 500, headers: headers, body: JSON.stringify({ status: "ERROR", message: "Decryption failed." }) };
            }
        }

        if (data.action === "getClientStatus") {
            if (!data.userEmail) return { statusCode: 400, headers: headers, body: JSON.stringify({ status: "ERROR" }) };

            try {
                const scanResult = await ddbDocClient.send(new ScanCommand({
                    TableName: TABLE_NAME,
                    FilterExpression: "userEmail = :email",
                    ExpressionAttributeValues: { ":email": data.userEmail }
                }));
                const userRecords = scanResult.Items || [];

                if (userRecords.length > 0) {
                    userRecords.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.timestamp) - new Date(a.timestamp));
                    return { statusCode: 200, headers: headers, body: JSON.stringify({ status: "SUCCESS", campaignStatus: userRecords[0].campaignStatus || "Pending", paymentConfirmed: userRecords[0].paymentConfirmed || false, finalFiles: userRecords[0].finalFiles || [] }) };
                } else {
                    return { statusCode: 200, headers: headers, body: JSON.stringify({ status: "SUCCESS", campaignStatus: "Unsubmitted", paymentConfirmed: false, finalFiles: [] }) };
                }
            } catch (dbError) {
                return { statusCode: 500, headers: headers, body: JSON.stringify({ status: "ERROR", message: dbError.message }) };
            }
        }

        if (data.action === "sendDocumentReminder") {
            const isAuthorized = await isStaff(data.adminEmail, accessToken);
            if (!isAuthorized) return { statusCode: 403, headers: headers, body: JSON.stringify({ status: "ERROR" }) };

            try {
                const reminderHtml = `<div style="padding: 30px; font-family: sans-serif;"><h2 style="color: #4f46e5;">FiscalX Reminder</h2><p>Please upload: <strong>${data.requestedDocName}</strong></p></div>`;
                await ses.send(new SendEmailCommand({
                    Source: SENDER_EMAIL, Destination: { ToAddresses: [data.clientEmail] },
                    Message: { Subject: { Charset: "UTF-8", Data: `Document Reminder` }, Body: { Html: { Charset: "UTF-8", Data: reminderHtml } } }
                }));
                return { statusCode: 200, headers: headers, body: JSON.stringify({ status: "SUCCESS" }) };
            } catch (err) {
                return { statusCode: 500, headers: headers, body: JSON.stringify({ status: "ERROR" }) };
            }
        }

        if (data.action === "updateBillingStatus") {
            const isAuthorized = await isStaff(data.adminEmail, accessToken);
            if (!isAuthorized) return { statusCode: 403, headers: headers, body: JSON.stringify({ status: "ERROR" }) };

            try {
                const scanResult = await ddbDocClient.send(new ScanCommand({ TableName: TABLE_NAME, FilterExpression: "userEmail = :email", ExpressionAttributeValues: { ":email": String(data.clientEmail) } }));
                const items = scanResult.Items || [];

                for (const item of items) {
                    await ddbDocClient.send(new UpdateCommand({
                        TableName: TABLE_NAME, Key: { "userEmail": item.userEmail, "timestamp": item.timestamp },
                        UpdateExpression: "set finalFiles = :f, paymentConfirmed = :p", ExpressionAttributeValues: { ":f": data.finalFiles || [], ":p": data.paymentConfirmed || false }
                    }));
                }
                return { statusCode: 200, headers: headers, body: JSON.stringify({ status: "SUCCESS" }) };
            } catch (err) {
